wide.prompt:
Use case: compositing, ads-marketing.
Asset: Chinese forum announcement hero for the private game 天使水族馆 v2.0. Produce ONE polished landscape 16:9 illustration designed for final 800×450 PNG delivery, with a generous safe margin.
Inputs: image 1 is the approved 萤光秘境 background, the base scene. Images 2/3/4 are approved insert assets: 青芽海龟 (green turtle), 绮霞古比 (apricot fish with pink fan tail and tiny crown), 珊澜蝶鱼 (cream/coral high-body fish with turquoise eye accent). Image 5 is a supporting reference sheet of the approved scenery assets: numbered 1 root cottage, 2 waterwheel mill, 3 low stone bridge, 4 beacon pillar, 5 small seed lantern. Extract only the illustrated objects from this sheet, never the sheet background, grid, numbers or English labels.
Compose these existing assets into ONE coherent underwater woodland aquarium scene. This is an artwork composite, not a new creature redesign, not a screenshot and not a collage grid. Preserve the recognizable exact creature designs, proportions, markings, fin shapes, crown, eye colors and silhouettes. Preserve the buildings' shapes/materials. Ignore transparent canvas/fringe artifacts in the insert files. Keep all three creatures fully visible, distinct and unoccluded. They float through the middle water at staggered depths; the turtle near upper-right midwater, the guppy left-center, butterfly right-center. Modest mirroring is allowed for inward-facing composition. Ground the cottage at lower-left, mill at lower-right with full wheel readable, smaller bridge on the low foreground floor, beacon and tiny lantern as sparse accents. Do not fill the frame with buildings; maintain airy open swimming water.
Style: match the existing softly painted green/aqua woodland, subtle warm seed-lamp light, a few fine glowing motes and watery light. Gentle magical aquarium, soft and welcoming, no neon/cyberpunk, no photorealism. Keep the original green background identity. The colorful fish are the visual accents.
Typography: exactly TWO lines of clean, correctly written Simplified Chinese, in the upper clear area, with subtle readable ivory/warm-gold type and no opaque label boxes. A large elegant title and a much smaller neat subtitle. Render verbatim:
Main line: “萤光秘境”
Subtitle line: “天使水族馆 v2.0 · 新伙伴与新布景”
There must be exactly these two text lines and no other text, logos, badges, prices, numerals beyond v2.0, watermarks, UI, tank frame or screen mockup. All words and subjects comfortably inside the 16:9 safe area, no cropped fins or text. Do not invent any new species, accessories or buildings.
